note: expected_deaths_per_decade: model-predicted direct deaths from the county's own 1996-2025 tornado and flash flood events, per 10 years. ref_*: predicted deaths for the same reference storm in every county (EF2 tornado, 5 mi x 200 yd, April; flash flood in July), so counties compare on vulnerability. All values are out-of-fold: predicted by a model that never saw the county's state.
